correctness.rationale: Lift a polygon to S^2: the terminal sheet is the product of signs of consecutive inner products, independent of individual lift signs. The sign-kernel operator on normalized S^2 has odd harmonic eigenvalues (-1)^k Catalan_k/2^(2k+1), multiplicity 4k+3 and Hilbert-Schmidt square sum one. Cyclic trace equals 1-2q_n for n>=3; use spectral tail c_k<=1/8 for k>=1 and parity to prove strict monotonicity; c_k<=1/16 for k>=2 gives |q_n-(1/2-3/2^(n+1)-7/2*(-1/8)^n)|<=18/16^n. Hemisphere-disagreement conditioning yields q3 and q4. Numerically recomputed 10,000-term traces for lengths 3,4,5,6,7,12: q3=0.31830988618379086, q4=0.4052847345693511; analytic convergence and all lengths are established by the harmonic proof, not finite sums.
